About the archive

Graham’s research, preserved and carried forward.

The research

This site continues Graham Freebody’s decades of work researching one UK branch of the Freebody family.

The master record

Family Historian remains the authoritative family record. This website is a deliberately limited public view, not an exhaustive encyclopedia.

The preserved website

Graham’s original website is retained privately as historical source material. Its introduction is preserved here as part of the history of the work.
